title: Inventory
subtitle: Track stock, log restocks, record waste.

errors.generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
errors.network: Couldn’t reach the server. Check your connection and try again.
errors.permissionDenied: You don’t have permission to change this.
errors.invalidValue: That value isn’t valid. Check it and try again.

tracking.notSaved: Nothing was saved for “{name}”. It may have been deleted, or your role may not be allowed to edit the menu at this branch.
tracking.off: Stock tracking is off for “{name}” — the storefront will no longer mark it sold out, and its count is cleared, so ticking the box again starts it at 0.
tracking.onEmpty: Tracking stock for “{name}”, but it has 0 left, so customers see it as sold out right away. Log a restock to put it back on sale.
